sloka: एतं दृष्ट्वा प्रमोदिष्ये व्यसने त्वामिवानघ ।जीवितं धारयिष्यामि मासं दशरथात्मज ।ऊर्ध्वं मासान्न जीवयं रक्षसां वशमागता ।। ५.६५.२४ ।।।।
transliteration: etaṁ dṛṣṭvā pramodiṣye vyasane tvāmivānagha ।jīvitaṁ dhārayiṣyāmi māsaṁ daśarathātmaja ।ūrdhvaṁ māsānna jīvayaṁ rakṣasāṁ vaśamāgatā ।। 5.65.24 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O Son of Dasaratha I will hold on to life for a month. Captured by the demons, I will not live for more than a month'.
